title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1971-04-29
source: Borrows other material to "recreate" show without cuts

ai_review.summary: Fans rave about the legendary 4/29/71 show yet lament that it has never been released, providing no concrete comments on sound quality or musical details.
ai_review.review: All three reviews focus on the frustration of the show's unavailability rather than its performance or recording fidelity. Reviewers claim the concert is superior to other shows from the era and demand a full release, but they give no specifics about song execution, mix clarity, or source type.

ai_rating.rationale: The reviews are uniformly negative regarding availability and contain no technical or musical assessment; fan enthusiasm suggests a good show but the lack of concrete information limits the rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No reviewer comments on soundboard, audience mix, clarity, or any technical aspects; only criticism about the recording being unavailable.
